calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, s.store_key, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.is_current, count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines, sum(f.quantity) AS units, min(f.sale_date), max(f.sale_date), sum(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS staff_lines, sum(CASE WHEN f.quantity<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND (s.store_id=102 OR s.store_name ILIKE '%Pit%')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold,
         count(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS lines
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  WHERE s.store_id = 102
    AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
    AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  GROUP BY ALL
), ret AS (
  SELECT p.sku, sum(r.quantity_returned) AS units_returned
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 102 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT sold.*, coalesce(ret.units_returned,0) AS units_returned
FROM sold LEFT JOIN ret USING (sku)
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, sku LIMIT 8

calls.statement:
SELECT (SELECT sum(units_sold) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_units,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT business_date) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS rpt_days,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=102 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT sum(f.quantity) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) WHERE s.store_id=102 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category='ZZ Test') AS test_units,
 (SELECT max(etl_loaded_at) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27') AS last_load
